impl LaneDrainForTheStrip {
    fn drain_controls_for_lane(&mut self, control: &mut Consumer<Record>) {
        while self
            .control_lane_consumer_for_this_strip
            .pending_records_for_the_block_count() as u64
            > u64::from(self.limit)
        {
            let Ok(record) = control.try_pop() else {
                break;
            };
            self.apply(record);
        }
    }
}
